decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a renamed and upgraded version of the established BASIC 518 trommel, so it builds directly on the firm's core screening know-how, and the positive market response gives clear feedback to learn from.
Mobile shredding is close to the firm's existing mobile machinery competence, and its own product page shows commitment, so the firm can assimilate early results and refine the line.

The high-speed grinder uses related mobile comminution knowledge, but it is only mentioned on the website and may overlap with Product E, so some risk of consolidation remains; keeping it to keep learning is still justified.

A stationary electric fine shredder sits further from the firm's mobile core and gets limited visibility, but it fits the stated push toward plant-based and resource-saving solutions, so keeping it supports building that knowledge.
The green-waste grinder targets the firm's established composting and biomass customers and draws on existing knowledge, though overlap with Product C could lead to a portfolio merge.

The single-shaft pre-shredders are close to the firm's core shredder expertise, have their own product page, and support the expansion into stationary plants, so the firm is well placed to improve them.
